name: Thanatos Complex
source:
Jason has been out of a job as of late when he comes across a very good offer posted in the news paper as a groundskeeper for a old apartment complex. He decides to go for a interview and from there the dark horrors of Thanatos Complex reveal themselves.

Made for TyranoBuilder Summer Game Jam 2018.

[From [url=https://godofmoxie.itch.io/thanatos-complex]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
杰森最近失业了，他在报纸上看到一份非常好的工作邀请，担任一栋旧公寓大楼的场地管理员。他决定去接受采访，从那里，塔纳托斯情结的黑暗恐怖显露出来。

专为2018年TyranoBuilder夏季游戏Jam制作。

[来自[url=https://godofmoxie.itch.io/thanatos-complex]Itch.io[/url]]
